activityDefinitions.customer.page-visit: Approved customer catalogue, consented Visitor and committed eligible destination.

activityDefinitions.customer.provider-handoff: Existing supported provider handoff or outcome supplied by the responsible server flow.

activityDefinitions.customer.account-action: Existing account signup, saved-item, alerts or support audit from the business writer.
activityDefinitions.customer.security-audit: Existing authenticated account security operation and approved safe outcome.
activityDefinitions.customer.device-access: Existing authorized session/access observation. Separate from intentional actions.
activityDefinitions.admin.audit-action: Existing authorized administrative audit. Project by verified actor and keep restricted targets separate.
activityDefinitions.admin.navigation-proposed: Deferred navigation and section observation pending an approved monitoring policy.
activityDefinitions.customer.navigation-proposed: Deferred account, legal, packages or in-page navigation gap. Collection requires approval.
